# CodeZero Academy

CodeZero Academy is a Georgian programming education platform that provides premium programming books, courses, and resources in the Georgian language.

## Purpose
To teach programming to Georgian speakers through high-quality educational content including books, video courses, mentoring, and AI tutoring.

## Target Audience
- Beginner and experienced developers in Georgia
- Students learning programming
- Professionals looking to improve their skills
- Georgian speakers seeking programming education in their native language

## Main Features
- **Premium Programming Books**: High-quality books on React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and other technologies
- **Video Courses**: Structured video courses with assignments and progress tracking
- **Mentoring**: Individual mentoring with experienced developers
- **AI Tutor**: AI-powered tutoring for programming questions in Georgian
- **Code Playground**: Online code editor for practice
- **Certifications**: Professional exams and certificates
- **Community**: Forums and leaderboards for learning together

## Technologies Covered
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vue.js
- Backend: Node.js, Python, Go
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- Tools: Git, Docker, CI/CD
- Mobile: React Native, Flutter

## Content Structure
- Books are organized by category and difficulty level
- Courses are structured by weeks with lectures and assignments
- Mentoring courses include syllabus and project-based learning
- Certifications validate skills through exams

## Business Model
- One-time purchases for books and courses
- Subscription-based access to premium content
- Free tier with limited access to basic content
- Bundles for multiple books at discounted prices

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Authentication: Supabase Auth
- Storage: Supabase Storage
- Payment: PayPal, Bank transfer
- Deployment: Vercel

## Language
All content is primarily in Georgian (ka), with some English technical terms preserved.
